strictly enforces relative `./docs/notes` path hygiene.\n  - Shared TypeScript contracts: `apps/web/types/canvasBridge.ts` (`ObsidianCanvasNode`, `ReactFlowNode`, `CanvasSyncRequest`, `CanvasSyncResponse`).\n  - Worker tag sanitization: worker names in markdown cards (`**Worker**: <name>`) must be stripped of backticks (`.strip().strip(\"\\`\")`) before badge lookup.\n- **Reference**: `references/interactive_canvas_triggers_and_react_flow_bridge.md`.\n\n## 🕸️ 40. Live Swarm HUD, Worker Color Mapping & WebSocket Broadcast Engine\n- **Real-Time Agent Telemetry on Visual Canvas**:\n  - `apps/api/routers/canvas_bridge.py`: `CanvasBridgeConnectionManager` manages WebSocket clients partitioned by `canvas_path` or global HUD listeners.\n  - Streaming method `broadcast_swarm_event()` propagates agent execution status without triggering heavy disk sync or full React Flow reloads.\n- **SSOT Swarm Worker Color Palette (`SWARM_WORKER_COLORS`)**:\n  - `core/orchestrator/visual_canvas_control.py`: Centralized palette linking agents (`gerych_prime`, `antigravity_mentor`, `gerych_builder`, `dnk_dev_fullstack`, `dnk_shopify`, `dnk_video_ai_creator`, `gerych_auditor`, `dnk_security_guard`, `herich_librarian`) to JSON Canvas color integers (`1` to `6`), UI Hex values, and emojis.\n- **REST & WebSocket Ingress**:\n  - REST: `POST /api/v1/canvas/bridge/events/swarm` (and `/swarm-hud` alias) accepts worker progress with optional `update_canvas_disk` flag.\n  - WebSocket: action `swarm_event` enables bidirectional in-browser debugging and client dispatch.\n  - Generates dynamic visual progress bars (e.g. `██████▒▒▒▒ 65%`).\n- **Reference**: `references/live_swarm_hud_and_websocket_broadcaster.md`.\n\n## 🕸️ 41. Critical Path Method (CPM), Float/Slack & Visual Bottleneck Heatmap\n- **Algorithmic Graph CPM (`NodeTaskGraphEngine.compute_critical_path`)**:\n  - Computes task duration based on priority/metadata (Completed = 0h, Critical = 8h, High = 5h, Medium = 3h, Low = 1.5h).\n  - Two-pass traversal: Forward Pass computes Earliest Start (`ES`) and Earliest Finish (`EF`); Backward Pass computes Latest Start (`LS`) and Latest Finish (`LF`).\n  - Total Float / Slack (`LS - ES`): nodes with `Slack <= 0.001` form the critical execution chain.\n  - Detects critical edges (`EF(u) == ES(v)`) and ranks bottlenecks by impact score (`out_degree * duration`).\n- **API Endpoint & Zustand Synchronization**:\n  - `GET /api/v3/node_tasks/critical_path`: Returns status, critical node IDs, critical edge IDs, total duration, and bottleneck rankings.\n  - `nodeTasksStore.ts`: Controls `showCriticalPath`, fetches metrics on demand, and feeds reactive states to canvas components.\n- **Visual Contrast & Dimming Heatmap**:\n  - `CustomTaskNode.tsx`: Critical nodes render blazing rose-neon ring (`ring-2 ring-rose-500 border-rose-500 shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(244,63,94,0.45)]`) and `CRITICAL PATH (Dur: Xh | Slack: 0h)` badge. Non-critical nodes dim to `opacity-40 saturate-50` for high contrast.\n  - `CustomDependencyEdge.tsx`: Critical edges stroke in `#f43f5e` (3px) with pulsing flame marker.\n  - `NodeTaskGraphCanvas.tsx`: Toolbar toggle `🔥 Critical Path` and floating analytical summary banner.\n- **Reference**: `references/dag_canvas_critical_path_method_and_heatmap.md`.\n\n## 🎬 42. Multimodal Gemini Imagen 3 & Vertical Video Storyboard Pipeline\n- **Living Node-Based Storyboard DAG**: Orchestrates viral video production (TikTok/Reels/Shorts) on the infinite canvas (`@xyflow/react`).\n- **Pipeline Architecture**: `StrategyMarkdownNode` (Audience/Pain points/Hook) -> `VideoStoryboardNoteNode` (9:16 scene cards, timings, voiceover, camera cues) <-> `PhotoStudioNode` (Vertex AI Imagen 3 programmatic generation) -> `VideoCreatorNode` (Remotion 9:16 video compilation).\n- **Asset Placement Invariant**: Generated 9:16 frames stored in `apps/web/public/media/storyboards/<topic>/frame_0X.jpg` for zero-overhead local web serving.\n- **Typography Separation Invariant**: NEVER prompt diffusion models (Imagen 3) to render text or numbers directly; render titles/metrics as vector DOM nodes or Remotion subtitle layers.\n- **Deferred Architecture Pattern**: When capturing concepts for later implementation, author full SSOT specs in `docs/notes/` and cross-link knowledge hubs before touching code.\n- **Reference**: `references/gemini_imagen_storyboard_canvas_pipeline.md`.\n\n## 🗺️ 43. CodeSpring Visual Planning, Context Boundaries & Scout Synthesis\n- **Visual Mind Map as Persistent Agent Memory**: The spatial canvas acts as the visual SSOT to prevent LLM context rot, repetitive prompts, and vibe-coding regressions across sessions.\n- **Spatial Boundary Hierarchy**: `ProjectNode` -> `FeatureNode` -> `SubFeatureNode` -> `BridgeNode` (metadata decoupling) -> `NotesNode` (low-token business rules) / `PRDNode` (UI, Backend, Database).\n- **Mockup-First PRD Invariant**: Always create and validate visual mockups / design tokens BEFORE formalizing technical PRDs to prevent encoding false assumptions into deep specs.\n- **5-Gate Codebase Audit Protocol**: Evaluate codebases against 5 non-negotiable gates (Functional Truth, Zero Fabrication, Architectural Viability, Extensibility, Runtime Stability) prior to canvas wrapping or import.\n- **Context Tagging (\"Tag First, Then Ask\")**: Scope agent execution to tagged nodes and connected PRDs to eliminate 80%+ irrelevant monorepo context.\n- **Scouts-to-Canvas Backlog**: Autonomous background monitors convert findings directly into draft `Feature Proposal` canvas cards.\n- **Reference**: `references/codespring_visual_planning_and_context_boundaries.md`.\n\n## 🌐 44. Spatial UI MVR: ReactFlow v11+, Zustand Store & HITL Approval Modal Architecture\n- **Interactive Spatial Graph SSOT**: Maps plugins, swarm agents, and system services into a 2D topological graph via Next.js 14/15 App Router and ReactFlow v11+.\n- **Node & Edge Specialization**: Custom nodes (`PluginNode`, `AgentNode`, `ServiceNode`) and semantic edges (`DependencyEdge`, `DataflowEdge`, `CapabilityEdge`).\n- **Zustand OCC Reactive Store**: Decoupled state management supporting optimistic client updates with 3-way merge conflict rollback upon backend version mismatch.\n- **Fail-Closed HITL Approval Gate**: Pre-execution modal interceptor for high-risk operations with side-by-side AST/JSON diff viewing, countdown timer, and automatic reject on disconnect.\n- **Reference**: `references/spatial_ui_mvr_reactflow_and_approval_patterns.md`.\n\n## 🌐 45. MVR Spatial Bridge, Resilient W3C SSE Reconnect & HITL Gateway\n- **Resilient W3C SSE Stream**: Ring buffer history catch-up (`get_events_since`) honoring `Last-Event-ID` header and `?last_event_id=` query param before live event attachment.\n- **Fine-Grained Spatial Updates**: Lightweight `CANVAS_NODE_MOVED` and atomic `CANVAS_BATCH_MUTATION` events routed to `gerych_builder`.\n- **HITL Bridge & Security Gate**: Interception of high-risk tasks into `WAITING_APPROVAL`, broadcasting `APPROVAL_REQUESTED` and `APPROVAL_RESOLVED`, with strict relative-path security enforcement.\n- **Artifact Retention**: Dual-layer TTL garbage collection pruning disk binaries, in-memory cache, and SQLite WAL metadata.\n- **Headless Async Streaming Testing**: Avoid synchronous `client.stream()` hangs by testing FastAPI generator endpoints directly via `response.body_iterator`.\n- **Reference**: `references/mvr_spatial_bridge_and_resilient_sse_reconnect.md`.\n\n## 🌐 46. Next.js 14 / XYFlow Frontend Wiring: Resilient SSE Stream, Optimistic HITL & AgentTaskNode\n- **W3C Resilient EventSource Client**: `MvrStreamClient` reconnecting with exponential backoff, caching `Last-Event-ID` in `sessionStorage`, and hydrating ring buffer history.\n- **Zustand Optimistic UI**: Instant status updates on 1-Click approval/rejection with automatic rollback if REST decision submission fails.\n- **Custom `AgentTaskNode` for XYFlow**: Dedicated visual cards with agent identity color palettes, live pulsating status badges, and inline 1-Click \"Approve\" / \"Reject\" controls.\n- **Defensive NodeData Normalization Invariant**: Custom React Flow nodes deserialized from static presets, JSON canvas files, or live agent events frequently omit secondary identifiers (`taskId`, `agentId`) or vary property names (`agent` vs `targetAgent`). To prevent fatal client-side crashes (`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'slice')`), components must normalize incoming data at the top with robust fallbacks:\n  `const nodeData = { ...rawData, taskId: rawData.taskId || id || 'task-unknown', targetAgent: rawData.targetAgent || rawData.agent || 'gerych_prime' };`\n  and defensively render identifiers: `{(nodeData.taskId || id || 'task').slice(0, 8)}`.\n- **Operator `HitlApprovalDrawer`**: Deep inspection of blast radius, affected files, diff viewer, and rejection rationale input.\n- **Reference**: `references/mvr_canvas_frontend_sse_hitl_wiring.md`.\n\n## 🌐 47. Synthetic Customer Swarm HUD & Funnel Stream Pattern (SAAP v1.0)\n- **Live SSE Funnel Streaming Adapter**: `simulation_client.ts` implementing W3C EventStream reader with automatic fallback to REST execution on transport disconnection.\n- **Custom `CustomerSwarmNode` for XYFlow**: Multi-tab HUD with live progress bars, per-step conversion rates and drop-offs, interactive parameter tuning, and evidence-grounded dissent cards (\"Hard-No\" objections).\n- **Node Registry & Engine Registration**: Registration across `DNKCanvas.tsx`, `CanvasEngine.tsx`, `mvr/page.tsx`, and `NodeRegistry.ts` under category `ecommerce`.\n- **Reference**: `references/synthetic_customer_swarm_canvas_hud_pattern.md`.\n\n## 🎬 48. Video Retention Auditor, Script Doctor & Surgical EDL Node Pattern\n- **Retention Curve & Attention Drop-off Visualizer**: Custom SVG vector path rendering with baseline guides and interactive `<circle>` drop-off markers linking to acoustic timestamps.\n- **Script Doctor 3-Hook Formulas**: Interactive formula picker (`CONTRARIAN_PATTERN_INTERRUPT`, `CURIOSITY_GAP_PARADOX`, `RESULT_FIRST_SHOWCASE`) with one-click script insertion and canvas handle dispatch.\n- **Edge Data Flow & Reactive Canvas Propagation**: Seamless automated propagation across `VideoStoryboardNoteNode` ➔ `RetentionAuditorNode` ➔ `VideoCreatorNode`. Triggered automatically on edge creation (`onConnect`) and on manual hook selection via `propagateDataFlow`, instantly updating prompt and script fields downstream and displaying active edge counters (`▲ In | ▼ Out`).\n- **Drag & Drop Local FFmpeg Media Audit**: Dropzone area for direct `.mp4`, `.mov`, `.webm` ingestion. Dispatches multipart uploads to FastAPI endpoint `/api/v1/video/retention/upload-and-audit` executing local FFmpeg scene change detection (`select=gt(scene,0.3)`) and silence profiling to locate static holds and awkward dead-air without third-party services.\n- **Surgical NLE EDL Export**: Real-time assembly of frame-accurate jump cuts, B-roll overlays, and silence trims with client-side `.edl` download.\n- **Node & Backend Gateway Registration**: FastAPI router `video_retention_router.py` mounted at `/api/v1/video/retention`, node registered in `NodeRegistry.ts` (category: `media`), `DNKCanvas.tsx`, and `CanvasEngine.tsx`.\n- **Offline Synthetic Fallback**: Fallback generator ensuring zero blank-states and graceful testability even during disconnected execution.\n- **SceneCut Model & In-Node Store Sync Invariants**: Downstream report generator expects typed `SceneCut` domain models (not raw floats); in-node hook applications mutate `useCanvasStore.getState().updateNodeData(id, ...)`.\n- **Reference**: `references/retention_auditor_spatial_canvas_node_integration.md`.\n\n## 🌐 49. SaaP FastMCP Plugins & Canvas Live HUD WebSocket Event Stream Invariants\n- **Strict ServiceRegistry Monorepo Invariant**: SaaP microservices reside EXCLUSIVELY in `services/dnk_*` and `packages/plugins/`. Business service discovery is strictly prohibited from searching `apps/` or `core/`.\n- **FastMCP Protocol, ServicePluginNode & Polymorphic Clones**: Every SaaP service exposes tool interfaces via Model Context Protocol (FastMCP) paired with a `widget_descriptor`. Represented in `core/canvas/canvas_engine.py` by `ServicePluginNode`. In graph snapshots (`take_snapshot`), never instantiate base `CanvasNode(...)` directly (Snapshot Downgrade pitfall) — always use polymorphic `.clone()` to preserve specialized attributes (`service_id`, `endpoints`, slots, descriptors).\n- **ServicePluginCard Manifest v1alpha2 & Progressive ToolRAG**: SaaP services declare `apiVersion: dnk.os/v1alpha2`, `kind: ServicePluginCard` declaring `fastmcp_tools`, `canvas_widgets`, and `governance` (`spend_guard`, `circuit_breaker`). `ProgressiveToolCatalog` dynamically discovers and injects relevant tools per prompt/goal keywords via `ServiceRegistry.get_fastmcp_tools_catalog()`, while contract tests branch on `kind` to support both legacy and v1alpha2 manifests.\n- **Harness ↔ Canvas Event Stream Bridge**: Continuous WebSocket streaming (`/api/v1/canvas/events/stream`) with HTTP Fallback Polling (`/api/v1/canvas/events/poll`) and SSE (`/api/v1/canvas/events/sse`). Manages heartbeat ping/pong (string & json), clean disconnects, and ring-buffered cursor pagination. Translates `HarnessEvent` deltas, tool calls, tool results, and circuit trips into real-time Canvas Live HUD telemetry (`HUD_TELEMETRY_STREAM`) and node transitions.\n- **Root Hygiene & Storage Guard**: Never target repo-root folders like `templates/` (e.g., `templates/canvas/approvals/`), as it violates the canonical 8-root directory standard and triggers `root_hygiene_guard.py` failures. Direct ephemeral state to `.data/` or pytest `tmp_path`.\n- **Reference**: `references/saap_fastmcp_and_canvas_live_hud_protocol.md`.\n\n## 🌐 50. ThoughtDAG Context Graph: Wires as Context, Requirement Notes & Staleness Fingerprints\n- **Wires are Context**: Edges determine LLM prompt context: Materials (content nodes) → References (dashed cross-chain) → Mainline (solid) → Directive.\n- **Fingerprinting & Staleness**: `computeUpstreamFingerprint` (FNV-1a/SHA-256) and `evaluateGraphStaleness` / `propagate_staleness_bfs` walk DAG descendants to flag stale downstream branches (`stale: true`), preserving `locked` decisions.\n- **Unified World SOTA Thought Canvas**: Combines Tributary recursive subtree layout (`measure_subtree_height`, `X_GAP=400`, `Y_GAP=40`), ThoughtDAG BFS staleness propagation, Understand-Anything AST blast radius badges, and Dark Teal styling (`#1e2022` / `#162c2f` / `#35d5d5`). See `references/world_sota_unified_thought_canvas.md`.\n- **Smart Context & Topological Re-evaluation**: `gatherSmartContext` resolves block handles and enforces token caps; `executeDAGReevaluation` runs level-by-level via Kahn's algorithm.\n- **Headless Pitfall**: In `flushDeltaSync`, guard with `if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' || typeof window === 'undefined') return;`.\n- **References**: `references/world_sota_unified_thought_canvas.md`, `references/thoughtdag_infinite_canvas_context_engineering_patterns.md`, `references/thoughtdag_contract_002_context_wires.md`, `references/thoughtdag_dsl_kahn_cycle_and_multiparent_merge.md`, `references/thoughtdag_fastmcp_and_studio_drawer_integration.md`, `references/thoughtdag_block_level_handles_and_text_selection_wiring.md`, `references/thoughtdag_staleness_indicators_and_branch_propagation.md`, `references/thoughtdag_smart_context_and_dag_reevaluation.md`, `references/thoughtdag_context_wires_and_graph_of_operations_architecture.md`.\n\n## 🌐 51. Operational Living Canvas vs Mockup Lock: Orchestrator Chat & Action Bridges\n- **Anti-Pattern: The Static Initialization Lock**: Guard strictly against canvas wrapper components (e.g. `DNKStudioWorkspace`) mounting aggressive `useEffect` hooks that overwrite the Zustand store with static decorative artboard mockups (`INITIAL_STITCH_NODES`) on empty state. When deploying new interactive node classes (`thoughtDagNote`, `agentTaskNode`), ensure default initialization boots an empty living board or genuine operational nodes rather than non-executable UI cards.\n- **Anti-Pattern: Decorative Prompt Docks (The Simulation Trap)**: Never leave command bars (e.g. `StitchPromptDock`) as cosmetic stubs displaying notification toasts (`handleNotification({ text: '✨ Запит передано...' })`) without real network dispatch. Every user prompt submission MUST route to the live orchestrator API endpoint (`/api/v1/orchestrator/chat` or `/api/v1/shell/dispatch`) with active `X-Workspace-ID` auth.\n- **Multi-Tier Live LLM Inference Invariant**: Orchestrator chat must NEVER rely on static canned replies. Always route through a live cascading inference engine: Primary Vertex AI (`gemini-3.8-flash`) -> Secondary NVIDIA NIM pool (`meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct`) -> Tertiary OpenRouter. Sync provider calls must be isolated in `asyncio.to_thread` with explicit `asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=10.0)` caps to prevent event-loop freezing.\n- **Defensive Node Prop Guards (Crash Prevention)**: Custom React Flow nodes (`AgentTaskNode`) must defensively guard string methods (e.g. `(data.taskId || id || 'TASK').slice(0, 8)`) to avoid unmounting the canvas when optional task identifiers are missing.\n- **Bidirectional Orchestrator Chat & SSE Streaming Protocol**: A spatial canvas is non-functional without an interactive Orchestrator Chat Panel. The orchestrator bridge must:\n  1. Inject active spatial context via `getSelectedNodeContext()` (selected note, upstream/downstream edges, neighbor labels) into chat requests, accompanied by a visual focus chip (`🎯 Фокус: <Title>`) with dismiss capability.\n  2. Stream real-time reasoning (`thought`), swarm routing (`status`), tool executions (`tool_call`, `tool_result`), and token deltas (`content_chunk`) over W3C SSE (`POST /api/v1/orchestrator/chat/stream`).\n  3. Emit structured canvas mutations (`canvas_mutation`: `add_note`, `add_agent_task`, `connect_wire`) that execute on-the-fly via Zustand's `applyCanvasActions()` with automatic collision offset.\n  4. Render thought streams and tool calls in collapsible accordions to avoid overwhelming the primary chat window.\n- **CapCut AI Design Orchestrator Cockpit Pattern**: The chat panel must strictly emulate the CapCut AI Design (`capcut.com/ai-design`) paradigm: deep `#121214` dark aesthetic, hero welcome state (\"Що ми створюємо сьогодні?\"), categorized swarm skills pill buttons (Video, Spec, Shopify, Builder, Security, Memory) that prefill prompts, signature floating input container with embedded actions (`+`, `🧊`, `📖`) and contrast submit arrow (`↑`), docked spatial node focus pill, and collapsible single-line thinking accordions (`💭 N thoughts • ⚡ N tools`).\n- **Deterministic Product Grounding Invariant**: Passing headless unit tests (`pytest`, `tsx --test`) is a necessary prerequisite but does NOT constitute a working product. Always verify the live web route (`/canvas`, `/shell`) in a browser or live HTTP client, confirming that UI controls physically trigger backend mutations and visual updates.\n- **References**: Action contracts in `references/live_orchestrator_chat_canvas_action_bridge.md`; spatial controls in `references/spatial_canvas_controls_and_node_drawer_event_bus.md`; dual-track execution in `references/dual_track_spatial_execution_and_human_agent_invariants.md`.\n\n## 🌐 52. Human — Ideas, Agents — Executors: Proposal Lifecycle & Identity Contracts\n- **The Core Boundary**: Humans author nodes; agents produce non-destructive `Proposal` objects (`pending` -> `applied`/`rejected`).\n- **LOD & OCC Invariants**: Identity models enforce progressive disclosure (`extract_lod_slice` <= 1,500 tokens) and OCC base versioning to prevent collision.\n- **Reference**: Full contracts and state machine in `references/human_in_the_loop_proposals_and_identity_contracts.md`.\n\n## 🌲 53. Landscape CAD, 3D WebGL, Irrigation, Lighting & Master BoQ\n- **2D/3D WebGL Engine**: 2D drafting with Three.js scene graph, `InstancedMesh` 2.5D billboards (1,000+ plants in 1-3 draw calls), GLSL seasonal shaders, and solar shadow vectors (Lat 44°–52° N).\n- **AI Vision & Cadastral**: SAM 2 segmentation, RDP smoothing, least-squares plane drainage vectors ($\\vec{D} = (-N_x, -N_y)$ per ДСТУ-Н Б В.1.1-27:2010), and ДБН clearances.\n- **Irrigation & 12V Lighting**: Hazen-Williams hydraulic friction loss / auto-zoning; Pouillet's voltage drop ($\\Delta U = 2 \\cdot I \\cdot \\frac{\\rho \\cdot L}{S} \\le 7-8\\%$), Multi-Tap boost (12V-15V), and IP68 + SELV $\\le 24\\text{V}$ water invariant.\n- **Master BoQ Estimator**: Ukrainian landscape market pricing standard with split material/labor accounting, 5-domain aggregation (Hardscape, Planting, Lawn, Irrigation, Lighting), logistics/contingency/overhead multipliers, and UAH/EUR/USD conversion.\n- **References**: `references/landscape_3d_cad_webgl_engine_patterns.md` and `references/landscape_lighting_and_master_estimator_patterns.md`.\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n", "path":
